name: Fixstars Corporation
summary: Fixstars Corporation operates as a software company in Japan and internationally. It operates through Solution Business and Saas Business segments. The company provides embedded acceleration, image processing algorithm development, distributed parallel system development, GPU acceleration, FPGA systems development, quantum computing, AI and deep learning, automotive software development, and firmware development for flash memory solutions.
